name: A/P Aging Summary
description: Returns the AP Aging summary report, showing outstanding vendor balances grouped into aging buckets, from the QuickBooks Online Report Service.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified customers. One or more comma separated customer IDs as returned in the attribute, Customer.Id, of the Customer object response code.

parameters.name: qzurl
parameters.description: Specifies whether Quick Zoom URL information should be generated for rows in the report. Quick Zoom URL is a hyperlink to another report containing further details about the particular column of data.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors. One or more comma separated vendor IDs as returned in the attribute, Vendor.Id, of the Vendor object response code.

parameters.name: date_macro
parameters.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. One or more comma separated department IDs as returned in the attribute, Department.Id, of the Department object response code.

parameters.name: report_date
parameters.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: aging_method
parameters.description: The date upon which aging is determined.
